text.tspan: People living in countries that sanction domestic violence
A country is defined as sanctioning domestic violence if legislation exists that includes criminal sanctions or
provides protection orders for domestic violence.
Data source: World Bank Gender Statistics (2025); Population based on various sources (2024)
